stemMd: Three fair coins are tossed independently. What is the probability of exactly one head?
explanationMd: There are eight equally likely sequences. Exactly one head can occur in three positions, giving three favourable sequences and probability 3/8.

distractorRationale.c: This confuses a single toss with the three-toss event.
distractorRationale.a: This counts only one of the three placements of the head.
distractorRationale.e: This is the probability of at least one head.
